entity_model_features.config.parrot_shou: Will automatically make parrot shoulder position follow the animated player position by default, this is not equivalent to the `parrot_left` and `parrot_right` attachment points as these will not rotate.
entity_model_features.config.sulfur_cube: Will automatically make Sulfur Cube internal blocks animate by default, this is equivalent to having a 'sulfur_cube_block' attachment in the model's 'cube' part with offset 0,0,0.
entity_model_features.config.asmmaths.lo: Will cause log spam, you probably don't need this unless the dev asked you to provide a log with this.
entity_model_features.config.asmmaths.to:
You almost always want this ON.
When disabled the animation system will defer to a more computationally expensive expression tree, which can be more useful for debugging.
entity_model_features.config.allowed_cem: Determines what models EMF will try to interact with. Note: this is not perfect, some mods just use the vanilla namespace ids and there is little EMF can do about it
In 1.21.9+ armor no longer naturally copies the custom animations of the base model, this replicates that old behaviour.
entity_model_features.config.export_rota:
exported jem models should not include the rotation values as they will inherit these from the vanilla parts
 however some model editors may like to have these values included
 this option will include them in the exported jem files
entity_model_features.config.optifine_fa:
If enabled this will make EMF try to load a fallback .properties file if the regular one cannot be found
E.G. pig_baby.jem will fall back to using pig.properties if pig_baby.properties doesn't exist.
OptiFine only works with these fallbacks and in fact does not allow the per model example like pig_baby.properties
entity_model_features.config.show_reload:
If enabled, this will show a toast message when errors occurred during a resource reload
This can be helpful to know if something went wrong during the reload
entity_model_features.config.load_warn.3: Check your log or EMF settings for details
entity_model_features.config.load_warn.2: EMF can log these errors again from, models > debug >
entity_model_features.config.load_warn.t: Log all loading errors again (with stacktrace)

This option will re-print all the encountered EMF loading errors, from the last resource reload, back into the log in the order they were encountered
Not all errors here will be very helpful as they may be missing surrounding log context
